name: vscode-claude-token-usage-bar-ext
description: Claude Code context-window fill, prompt cache state, a compact nudge and 5-hour / 7-day plan usage in one status bar item.

commands.title: Claude Token Usage Bar Ext: Refresh Now
Claude Token Usage Bar Ext: Show/Hide

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.contextWind.description: Fallback context-window size in tokens, used when the model can't be auto-detected (see vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.autoDetectContextWindow).

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.autoDetectC.description: Pick the context-window size from the session's model (current models = 1M, Haiku 4.5 = 200k). Falls back to vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.contextWindow when the model is unknown.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.refreshMs.description: How often to check the logs and refresh the status bar, in milliseconds. Only newly appended data is read.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.barWidth.description: Width of the context bar graph in characters.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.showCache.description: Show the estimated prompt cache state (minutes left, or cold).

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.cacheTtlMin.description: Prompt cache TTL used when the transcript doesn't say which TTL the last cache write used. 60 for Pro/Max within plan usage; 5 on usage credits or an API key.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.compactNudg.description: Periodically flash 'Compact before closing' while the context is large and the cache is still warm.
Only nudge when the context holds at least this many tokens.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.planUsage.s.description: Mark the plan usage reading as stale in the tooltip when it is older than this.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.planUsage.a.description: When Claude Code's saved reading is stale, fetch plan usage from Anthropic's internal OAuth usage endpoint using Claude Code's token. Undocumented; may break. Shares a small rate budget with Claude Code.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.planUsage.p.description: Minimum minutes between API fallback requests (only while the window is focused).

enumDescriptions: Track the newest session of the currently open workspace's project (closest to 'current session').
Track the newest session across all projects.
vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.scope.description: Which session the context and cache parts reflect.

vscodeClaudeTokenUsageBarExt.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to place the item on.
